VERSION 3.30.0.108
AFFECT /qml/common/Values.qml
 TRAVERSE Item
 LOCATE BEFORE ALL
 INSERT { signal dispatchOpenRequested() }
 END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
 TRAVERSE Background#root
 LOCATE BEFORE ALL
 INSERT {
   Loader {
     id: dispatchDocumentMenuLoader
     anchors.fill: parent
     z: 30000
     onLoaded: {
       if (item) item.openDispatch();
     }
     onStatusChanged: {
       if (status === Loader.Error)
         console.warn("Dispatch shortcut loader:", sourceComponent ? "component error" : source);
     }
   }
   Connections {
     target: Values
     function onDispatchOpenRequested() {
       if (!root.visible || !root.documentViewActive || root.passcodeHandler.userLocked) return;
       if (dispatchDocumentMenuLoader.item) {
         dispatchDocumentMenuLoader.item.openDispatch();
       } else if (dispatchDocumentMenuLoader.status !== Loader.Loading) {
         dispatchDocumentMenuLoader.setSource(
           "file:///home/root/.local/lib/remarkable-dispatch-shortcut/DispatchLauncher.qml",
           {appRoot: root, appWindowsRoot: navigator});
       }
     }
   }
 }
 END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SettingsMenu.qml
 IMPORT common 1.0
 TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
 LOCATE BEFORE ALL
 INSERT {
   function dispatchCloseNotebookMenu() {
     var container = Toolbar.geometry.container;
     if (!container) return;
     for (var i = 0; i < container.children.length; i++) {
       var child = container.children[i];
       if (typeof child.closeFoldout === "function") { child.closeFoldout(); return; }
     }
   }
 }
 TRAVERSE Component#settingsComponent > ColumnLayout#content
 LOCATE BEFORE ALL
 INSERT {
   ToolbarTool {
     group: ToolbarModel.ToolGroup.Utility
     Layout.fillWidth: true
     label: "Dispatch"
     visible: root.documentType === "note" || root.documentType === "pdf"
     shouldShow: root.documentType === "note" || root.documentType === "pdf"
     iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/send"
     onPressed: { root.dispatchCloseNotebookMenu(); Values.dispatchOpenRequested(); }
   }
 }
 END TRAVERSE
 END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
